$comment: Transcribed from the JSX of the local coda.co clone and the section/template data in design-repo/. Only these 15 routes exist in the clone; every other coda.co link is an inert '#'. Repeated callout.feature nodes are listed once at their position in the run; run lengths are 4 (codapay, webstore, distribution, consumer-platforms, giftcloud), 2 (coda-links), 3-5 (solution-standard: dating 3, digital-entertainment 3, esim 4, lms 4, merchant-of-record 5) and 4-5 (solution-impact: creator-economy 4, online-gaming 5).

meta.title: Coda clone – information architecture
meta.source: Local clone of coda.co (Vite + React) covering 15 of the site's routes
meta.notes: Copy evidence differs by route: homepage exact from a saved page; five inner pages real text from saved copies; nine pages original AI-written copy. See design-repo/README.md.

categories.SHELL: Site-wide chrome: fixed header with its dropdown menus, the footer, and the layout spacer that seats the closing band.
categories.HERO: The opening block of a route: headline, one supporting line, calls to action.
categories.PRODUCT: Product and capability explanation: cards, callouts, toolkit grids, integration options.
categories.PROOF: Evidence and credibility: headline figures, big-number cards, awards, press logos.
categories.CONTENT: Interactive or list-style content the visitor works with: FAQ, tables, cross-links, article carousels.
categories.COMMERCE: Pricing and conversion: price cards, product cross-sell, and the closing call-to-action.

shell.navbar.description: Fixed header: wordmark, four hover-dropdown categories (Products, Solutions, Resources, Company), a Pricing link, language, login and get-started buttons; a full-screen menu below the mobile breakpoint. Hides while scrolling down.

shell.footer.description: Site footer: wordmark and social row, four link columns, legal links and copyright.

spacer.footer-gap.description: Zero-height layout spacer that sits between the last content section and the closing band so they overlap correctly.
spacer.footer-gap.scope: Sits before the closing band on the routes that end with an FAQ; 13 routes.

hero.main.description: Opening block: optional product icon row, h1, one supporting paragraph, up to two buttons, and on some routes a publisher-logo marquee or a hero video/image.

products.highlight.description: Product cards on a dark tile grid. The homepage shows the full product set with hover image swaps; inner product pages show a single cross-sell card.
products.highlight.scope: The homepage plus the four product pages that cross-sell.

benefits.stack.description: Grey-card benefits grid: a section heading over a row of icon cards.
benefits.stack.scope: Every route except the pricing page (14 routes); some routes carry it twice.

features.stack.description: Feature cells separated by hairlines, optionally with a heading, a wide media band and a closing button.

features.grid.description: Toolkit grid of feature cards under a heading, wrapped in a full-width rounded panel.

callout.feature.description: Two-column callout: text block (icon, heading, paragraph, optional link) beside one product mockup; the media side alternates down a run of callouts. A dual-panel variant is used on the consumer-platforms page.
callout.feature.scope: One run per route on every route that has feature callouts (13 routes); run length varies by template.

callout.isolated.description: Single dark rounded panel with a heading, one-line body, docs button and a wide screenshot.

highlight.mega.description: Large dark rounded panel: heading, a wide media band, then a set of feature cards or a table.
highlight.mega.scope: Webstore and distribution product pages and all industry and use-case pages (9 routes).

bridge.section.description: Standalone heading with optional short description that introduces a run of callouts.
bridge.section.scope: Routes that open a callout run with its own heading (9 routes).

tiles.page.description: Two illustrated navigation tiles under a heading; their destinations lie outside the cloned routes, so they are inert links.

comparison.integration.description: Three integration options as image cards with a closing docs button.

impact.figures.description: Big-number proof block: coloured rounded panel with a heading and a few figure cards.
impact.figures.scope: Six product pages and two industry pages (8 routes).

metrics.band.description: Charcoal band of four headline company figures with a heading.
metrics.band.scope: Homepage and the use-case and industry pages that carry it (8 routes).

awards.recognition.description: Row of award badges with title, source and a learn-more link.

carousel.press.description: Auto-scrolling strip of press-outlet logos under a heading.

carousel.cards.description: Draggable 'Explore more' carousel of three cards on a grey rounded panel, with previous/next arrows.
carousel.cards.scope: Every route except the pricing page (14 routes).

faq.accordion.description: Frequently-asked-questions accordion on a soft grey rounded panel; every item starts collapsed.
faq.accordion.scope: Routes that end with an FAQ (13 routes).
faq.accordion.implementedBy: src/lib/enhance/faq.js (behaviour) on markup inline in src/pages/*Page.jsx

table.payment-method.description: Interactive payment-method table with a Type tab (rows of logos) and a Country tab (searchable list of countries).

pricing.price-stack.description: Two pricing cards: standard (rate columns) and custom (contact sales).
pricing.price-stack.scope: The pricing page and the four product pages that end with pricing.

cta.pre-footer.description: Closing dark call-to-action band directly above the footer.
